Maya (CS): Kickoff: HelioMint reserved bring-up. Need to finalize quota buckets, burst billing visibility, autoscale policy, and load-test windows. cc @Ethan @Rina @Alex
Ethan (Eng): Contract says 100 sustained tokens/s, 320 burst for 10m. They requested 45-day ramp. Question: are we comfortable with putting burst on a separate metered bucket?
Alex (AE): Customer insists on separate charge line for bursts so finance can reconcile. They'll only sign if Console shows a burst usage view for 30 days.
Rina (SRE): We can emit a burst_tag and a billing-meter metric. Ops needs to approve ephemeral headroom up to 3x base during probes. Also propose autoscale threshold: token_queue_length > 20ms for 90s -> scale. Keeps cold starts low.
Ethan (Eng): I'll implement a composite autoscaler: primary on token throughput, fallback to CPU. Set min-ready=2, cooldown=120s, max_replicas = base * 3. Name it "heliomint-bounded-v1".
Maya (CS): Load-test plan suggestion: (1) Cache prime 2h at 60% commit, (2) Spike probe: five 6m bursts to 320 over a 45m window, (3) Mixed-length regression 1h. Preferred window: Thu 02:00-05:00 PT.
Rina (SRE): Thu 02:00 PT works. Runbook: abort if 5xx > 0.8% sustained over 10m or p95 > 300ms for 15m. Rollback steps included.
Ethan (Eng): I'll drop a k6 script and a small priming example in docs. Example snippet: ```for p in warm_prompts: client.generate(p)```
Alex (AE): I'll get finance to sign billing-tag consent now and post confirmation here.
infra-bot: autoscale policy "heliomint-bounded-v1" queued for staging deploy by Ethan at 2024-05-01T09:12:03Z
Rina (SRE): Staging canary running now. Initial metrics: p95=172ms, errors=0.09%, cache-hit=68% with warm prefixes. Looks healthy.
Maya (CS): Success criteria to record: p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.6%, < 4 cold-starts during any 10m spike. If breached in first 30 days escalate renewal risk and offer an optimization session.
Ethan (Eng): Drafted k6 command: ```k6 run --vus 150 --duration 45m --rps 320 ./load/heliomint_spike.js``` will push to repo in 30m.
Alex (AE): Finance consent posted: shared drive link <https://drive.company/heliomint-finance-consent>
Maya (CS): Great. Action items: Ethan - k6 + docs snippet + push autoscale; Rina - book test window + runbook + canary; Alex - finance consent; Maya - enablement invite + feedback form + collect token distribution from HelioMint.
Ethan (Eng): On it, will update this thread when scripts are ready.
Rina (SRE): Test slot reserved Thu 02:00-05:00 PT. I'll post results here after the run.
Maya (CS): Thanks team  If any blocker, flag in thread. Otherwise I'll send invites and feedback link tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
